Let's say a vampire A gets blocked while performing an action.
Both vampires are ready at the end of that combat.
Vampire A taps his Ambulance.

Can the blocking vampire play a Psyche! ?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


He could have before A tapped the Ambulance.
If he passed in that window, then it is too late to play Psyche!
